overview_description.description: They love science and engineering. But some critical problems in the world cannot be solved because scientists and engineers lack the computing power to do the calculations. To solve this, Vorticity is developing domain specific accelerators with an initial focus on fluid dynamics. Their proprietary compute architecture solves fluid dynamics problems 1,000+X faster than any state of the art CPU/GPU cluster. We are now starting to expand this technology to other applications areas.
